new_input_conditions: deep with very mild synthetic grain
deep with stronger synthetic chroma corruption
intended_question: Can matching identical words to different photographic conditions teach safe image-dependent parameters and quality decisions, rather than a fixed text-to-enhancement lookup?
cautions: Synthetic corruption creates a domain gap and possible shortcut; it cannot certify real-photo safety.
Every final edit/decline must have direct visual evidence. Uncertain or failed proposals do not enter training.
No protocol or model training is started here. Preserve round9 failure and the original shared16GPUh cap.

light.zh: 请显著提亮这张照片，保留自然色彩和细节，不要明显放大噪声。
light.en: Brighten this photograph substantially while preserving natural colour and detail, without markedly amplifying noise.

compound.zh: 请增加照片对比度，稍微提亮，并让颜色更鲜明；保留主体、天空和暗部细节，不要明显放大噪声。
compound.en: Increase contrast, brighten the photograph a little, and make the colours more vivid while retaining subject, sky and shadow detail without markedly amplifying noise.

cases.decision_status: All new decisions pending direct visual review; no automatic decline or parameter admission
cases.note: Mild-noise input is a counterexample to refusing every imperfect image. Compensated severe-noise alternatives must be checked; a visibly good feasible edit takes precedence over the proposed refusal.
